listing.name: Brave Fencer Musashi / Alexbeav PSXRecomp
listing.summary: Native Brave Fencer Musashi PlayStation recompilation from Alexbeav’s PSXRecomp project.

steps.title: Prepare the Mac toolchain and setup kit
steps.instruction: Install Xcode Command Line Tools, CMake, Ninja and Python 3. Verify that the tools are on PATH, then unpack the official Intel or Apple Silicon ZIP that matches your Mac into a separate writable folder.

steps.title: Supply your original files
steps.instruction: Use your original four-track USA SLUS-00726 disc, keeping its complete CUE and every referenced track together. This kit requires your own retail SCPH-1001 BIOS dump. Follow the kit’s README-SETUP.txt for the image format and BIOS options.

steps.title: Build and add the prepared player
steps.instruction: From the unpacked folder, run Brave_Fencer_Musashi_Recompiled and follow its Generate & rebuild wizard. In Portcove, select build-release/Brave_Fencer_Musashi_Recompiled as the program and build-release as the start folder. Keep the external runtime and use upstream instructions for replacement.

warnings: Mac setup uses the upstream kit and your local toolchain. Mac build, gameplay and populated saves remain unobserved.

references.title: Updates and backups
references.instruction: Preserve the entire working folder with its saves, settings, overlay captures, original disc files and any required BIOS. Keep a copy of the creating runtime before updating the kit.

presentation.manual_preparation: Provide your own matching four-track CHD for Brave Fencer Musashi SLUS-00726 (USA) and a legally obtained retail SCPH-1001 BIOS. Preserve all disc tracks. Portcove verifies the first data track and track count; other tracks and the complete TOC are not independently authenticated. OpenBIOS is not an accepted substitute. Managed preparation uses the registered Python/build toolchain and Play skips the setup launcher. Generation, runtime, audio, saves, lifecycle and gameplay are untested. Preserve title GPL-3.0-only, framework PolyForm Noncommercial and UI MIT notices; no rights to retail game data or generated retail content are inferred. Linux x86-64 uses the pinned managed build toolchain and does not launch the packaged setup host. That standalone host requires GLIBC 2.29, GLIBCXX 3.4.26 and OpenGL; generated-game minimum-host compatibility and Linux runtime behavior remain untested.
